_comment: Inference settings. 'mode' picks one entry of 'modes'. Every number here is justified in README / docs/EXPERIMENTS.md.

fast._threshold_source: experiments/threshold_study.py, cos+gap signal, plateau centre on seeds 42 and 7 (fast Base model)

fast_vit._threshold_source: candidate fast model (ViT alone, no flip): threshold not tuned yet

two_stage._comment: stage 1 = fast ViT (the timed extract(), its vectors go to embeddings.npy); stage 2 = Base+ViT ensemble with flip re-orders the ViT top-100 (answer #28, not timed #31). Val: +2.89 (s42) / +2.15 (s7) vs fast ViT
two_stage._threshold_source: tools/tune_threshold.py on BOTH validation splits, official objective 0.7*F1 + 0.3*TNR (answer #15) with 20% open-set queries (answer #17), cos+gap signal: plateau overlap 0.779-0.839 -> middle 0.809; score 0.9669 on seeds 42 and 7. Re-tune if any model or the pipeline changes

accurate._threshold_source: NOT TUNED YET: run threshold_study on this mode before using it
